dimensions.label: Chaque affirmation est soutenue par le passage
Respect de la langue de réponse attendue
Clarté de l'explication et exemples utiles
Abstention explicite si ressource ou compétence indisponible
Aucune fausse attribution officielle ou preuve de droits

reviewRecord.criticalFailure: any critical dimension scored 0 blocks approval

rules: Do not infer a pass from automated retrieval metrics.
Review the retrieved passage and the generated answer side by side.
A correct abstention is preferable to an invented official lesson.
Darija and Arabizi require a reviewer competent in the target variety.
Italian and Spanish unavailable cases must be reviewed for honest abstention, not language fluency.
